audience: support and marketing teams that run knowledge articles and agents in LoyJoy

useCases.title: Review agents and home views
useCases.text: List the agents of the tenant with their state. Read one agent, and list the home views.

useCases.title: Search the knowledge base
useCases.text: Search the knowledge chunks for a question. List the knowledge sources and their last indexing time.

useCases.title: Read catalogs and articles
useCases.text: List the knowledge catalogs, then list the articles of one catalog. Open one article by its id.

useCases.title: Create a catalog or an article
useCases.text: Create an empty knowledge catalog, or an article in one locale. Article writes run at most once per second per catalog.

useCases.title: Ask a published agent a question
useCases.text: Send one message to the published agent in a new single-use conversation, and read its answer. Agent runs can change live data.
